title: Binance Earn Upgrades Dual Investment RFQ
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians,    Binance Earn is excited to introduce major upgrades to  Dual Investment RFQ  (previously known as Bespoke Dual Investment), designed to provide users with greater flexibility, accessibility, and efficiency. Key Updates 1. Flexible Settlement Days Tailor your strategy by selecting  any   business day  as your settlement date: BTC, ETH, & BNB Dual Investment:  Settle on any business day within  180 days . Other Tokens:  Settle on any business day within  90 days . Note : Subscriptions will close by  16:00 UTC  the day prior to settlement. 2. Zero Barriers to Entry Dual Investment RFQ is now available to  all eligible Binance users . The requirement of maintaining an equivalent balance exceeding $300,000 has been removed.   3. Streamlined App Experience Choose from  pre-set trading pairs and target prices  in just a few taps on the Binance App, simplifying your subscription process. Benefits of Dual Investment RFQ 1. Customization:  Tailor investments by setting a personalized target price and settlement date.  2. Greater Liquidity:  Enjoy access to over 30 different assets, providing greater liquidity and potential for higher rewards.  3. Block Trading:  Benefit from the advantages of block trading, allowing for larger subscription volumes and efficient execution of significant trades. How to Get Started via Binance App  1. Tap  [Earn]  on the Binance App homepage.  2.  Tap  [High Yield]  -  [Dual Investment]. 3. Choose  [Dual Investment RFQ]  at the top of the page.  Try Dual Investment RFQ Now! For More Information: What is Dual Investment RFQ   Top 6 Dual Investment Trading Strategies Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-10
